**Diagnostics** (the fastest way to help me): open **Settings → Info → Copy diagnostics** and paste it here. It lists versions, system, graphics, updates and a health check, and no file names.
If something looks broken, `Ctrl+K` then "Health check" copies a report too (on Windows, `kinoz.exe --doctor` runs the full Doctor).

**Log** (optional): `logs/app.log` in the data folder (the last two runs are kept as `app.previous.log` and `app.previous2.log`, so a crash is still there after you reopen kinoz). Please skim it for file names before pasting.
